hero.introduction: Connecting businesses, investors and institutions through exhibitions, trade missions, investor forums and strategic roundtables.

events.title: AGMEX — Green Mobility & Energy Expo
events.organizer: AGMEX Secretariat in strategic partnership with Teba Connects
events.tebaRole: Strategic Advisory Partner & International Delegation Lead
events.audience: Clean mobility manufacturers, renewable energy financiers, transport ministers, fleet operators, and grid infrastructure developers.
events.participationOptions: Exhibitor Booths, Country Pavilions, Delegate Passes, Corporate Title Sponsorship

details.overview: Africa's premier platform dedicated to accelerating electric mobility, renewable energy systems, grid infrastructure, and sustainable supply chains across the continent.
details.whoShouldAttend: Electric vehicle OEMs, solar/wind developers, battery manufacturers, sovereign infrastructure funds, and regulatory policymakers.
details.exhibitorSponsorOptions: Standard & premium modular booths (9m² - 72m²), national pavilion sponsorship, executive networking lounge branding, and keynote speaking slots.
details.delegationPackage: Curated B2B matching with vetted public-private counterparties, ministerial roundtables, site visits to renewable facilities, and dedicated ground logistics support.
details.agendaVenue: Millennium Hall, Addis Ababa. Three-day format: Day 1 Policy & Ministerial Summit; Day 2 B2B Deal Rooms & Technical Showcases; Day 3 Trade Delegations & Site Expeditions.
details.inquiryFormText: Inquire for AGMEX Delegation or Booth

events.title: CAWEE — Market Linkage Program
events.venue: Regional Trade Hubs (Ethiopia, Kenya, UAE) & Virtual Showcases
events.organizer: Center for Accelerated Women's Economic Empowerment (CAWEE) & Teba Connects
events.audience: Female entrepreneurs, SME exporters, international retail buyers, supply chain leaders, and developmental finance institutions.
events.participationOptions: SME Cohort Enrollment, International Buyer Pass, Technical Partner, Program Benefactor

details.overview: Structured cross-border export linkage program connecting over 6,500 women-led SMEs and 240,000 youth with international commercial buyers across the USA and Arabian Gulf.
details.whoShouldAttend: Commercial importers, ethical fashion & textile distributors, specialty coffee buyers, handicraft retailers, and bilateral trade agencies.
details.exhibitorSponsorOptions: Bespoke product display pavilions at international expos, institutional sponsorship of SME cohorts, and digital B2B catalog inclusion.
details.delegationPackage: Pre-screened supplier matchmaking, certified product compliance dossiers, curated buyer-seller speed meetings, and commercial contract follow-through.
details.agendaVenue: Hybrid delivery across Addis Ababa exhibition venues, Dubai trade hubs, and structured virtual procurement salons.

events.title: Africa Investment Circle — Dubai
events.venue: Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) / Address Downtown, Dubai, UAE
events.organizer: Africa Investment Circle in partnership with Teba Connects
events.audience: Sovereign wealth managers, GCC family office principals, private equity partners, commercial banks, and bankable project sponsors.
events.participationOptions: By Invitation Only — Limited Delegations, Project Pitch Slots, and Co-Host Sponsorship

details.overview: Exclusive closed-door executive salon matching Gulf institutional capital with bankable infrastructure, renewable energy, agribusiness, and logistics projects across Africa.
details.whoShouldAttend: Accredited institutional allocators, sovereign fund directors, and vetted project sponsors seeking $25M+ growth capital.
details.exhibitorSponsorOptions: Co-host presenting sponsorship, private deal-room branding, and closed-door roundtable hosting privileges.
details.delegationPackage: Access to verified investment dossiers, pre-arranged 1-on-1 private deal meetings, high-level networking receptions, and post-forum follow-through governance.
details.agendaVenue: DIFC, Dubai. High-level one-day convening with closed-door deal salons, keynote macroeconomic briefings, and executive dining.
details.inquiryFormText: Request Invitation for Africa Investment Circle
